name: handoff-guard
description: Replaces auto-compact with the handoff skill: at a context threshold, write a handoff, /clear, and feed the handoff into the fresh session. An active /goal is set again afterwards.

threshold.title: Threshold in percent
threshold.description: The handoff starts once the context window reaches this usage.

fallbackAt.title: Fallback in percent
fallbackAt.description: From this usage on, the guard allows normal compaction again in case the handoff didn't finish.

skill.title: Handoff command
skill.description: Name of the skill (without slash) that writes the handoff.

autoClear.title: Automatic /clear
autoClear.description: Run /clear by itself after the handoff. Off: the guard waits until you type /clear.

resume.title: After /clear
resume.description: immediately: Claude reads the handoff and continues right away. next-prompt: the handoff is silently attached to your next message.
